findings.evidence: The roadmap at README.md:187-191 explicitly requires, for finite-dimensional simple `S`, the collapse `End_k S ≃ₐ[k] k`; grep finds no `Module.End` algebra equivalence in this PR, only the generic declaration at Schur.lean:107.
findings.fix: Add a named specialization for `Nonempty (Module.End A S ≃ₐ[k] k)` with the appropriate scalar-tower/central-action and finite-dimensional hypotheses, proved via `algEquiv_self_of_finiteDimensional_divisionRing`.
findings.issue: Only the generic division-algebra equivalence is exposed; there is no theorem giving `Module.End A S ≃ₐ[k] k` for a finite-dimensional simple `A`-module, which is the Layer 1 consumer-facing product.

summary: The public API omits the roadmap’s explicit simple-module endomorphism-ring collapse, leaving downstream users to reconstruct the central Schur specialization.
